title: Tara Swart's husband's death and doves
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tara Swart's husband's death and doves, about unspecified at Tara Swart's house, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: her husband actually passed under unfortunate circumstances and then I think a bunch of doves showed up at her house

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a woman named Tara Swart whose husband died under unfortunate circumstances. He says that afterwards, as he understands it, a flock of doves showed up at her house, which he tells as a possible sign or message linked to the death.
